The final chapter

A letter for you, Maimuna

A few words from me to you.

← PREVIOUS PAGE

Happy birthday, my Maimuna. ❤️

When we started as friends in 2024, I never knew our story would bring us here. Then 2026 came, feelings grew, and on 12 April we became a couple. That day became one of the most special memories in our story.

We've had our ups and downs, and things haven't always been perfect, but I'm grateful for the memories we've made and for the fact that we're still here, together. I hope this new year of your life brings you happiness, peace, laughter and everything good you deserve.

Thank you for being part of my story. Here's to more beautiful memories, more laughter and more chapters still waiting for us.

Happy birthday, Mitchelle. Happy birthday, Maimuna. ❤️

With love,
Someone who is grateful for you.
